title: Mood tracker
subtitle: Track your mood and stress level changes

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing overview
wellbeing.subtitle: Your self-reported mood, stress, energy and focus over the last 10 days
wellbeing.entries: Based on {count, plural, one {# mood entry} other {# mood entries}}
wellbeing.empty: No complete mood entries for the last 10 days. Record how you feel to see your overview.
wellbeing.disclaimer: A personal trend indicator based on your check-ins, not a medical assessment. Lower stress contributes positively.

progress.heading: Wellbeing progress
progress.subtitle: How your check-ins have changed over the last 30 days
progress.stressSubtitle: Average self-rating across the last 7 calendar days (0 = lowest, 100 = highest)
progress.chartAccessible: Daily average mood and stress ratings for the past 30 days on a scale of 1 to 5
progress.empty: Add mood check-ins to see your progress.
progress.loadError: Unable to load your statistics. Try refreshing the page.
progress.disclaimer: A reflection of your self-reported ratings, not a medical assessment or diagnosis. A higher score means more stress.
progress.dateNote: Compares the last 7 days with the preceding 7, using days with check-ins (at least 2 each week). Daily aggregates currently use UTC.
progress.dateNoteLocal: Compares the most recent 7 calendar days with the previous 7 (at least 2 observed days per week). All dates and streaks use your time zone.
